title: High Temp O-Ring Kit
description:
High Temp O-Rings come
standard on all stainless steel tips (M), Titanium Tips and OmniVap Condenser and Mouthpiece Assemblies.
This kit comes with five O-rings and will keep your vapcap running smooth and free of unnecessary problems.
Included
5 x High Temp O-rings
